Lobby group · Federal

The Centre for Israel and Jewish Affairs / Le Centre consultatif des relations juives et israéliennes

Public records Bl00d Money ✓Verified in public records

Advocacy organization with an active federal in-house lobbying registration (959914-111, since 2001-11-20; responsible officer Noah Shack, CEO; registered as Canada-Israel Committee 2008–2012). Registered subjects include hate-speech and Criminal Code policy, Canada Community Security Program funding, Canada–Israel relations and trade, Iran policy, immigration, charity tax policy and Holocaust education.

Also known as: CIJA, Centre for Israel and Jewish Affairs, Canada-Israel Committee, Le Centre consultatif des relations juives et israéliennes
